dmn_experiences.title: The Liverpool Craft Beer Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided craft beer tour visiting two Liverpool microbreweries and two beer-focused pubs, with tutored tastings and the chance to meet the brewers. A beer expert explains the ingredients and brewing techniques along the way.
highlights: Tutored tastings across a range of beer styles
Roughly 1.5 miles of mostly flat walking
Suitable for newcomers and enthusiasts alike
